blocks: BasicWaves keys with moving waveform shape and expression-controlled sub level and decay.
Saved export: September 28, 2026 MIDI Control Center user-bank archive, computer-bank slot 249, file 249-09282026 6h14-A249.mbp. The computer-bank slot differs from this page’s observed device slot.
The parameter payload matches Factory 2.0, 2.1, 3.0 and 6.0. This is an archived factory-equivalent baseline; it does not establish the instrument’s saved or unsaved state during a later session.
Model: BasicWaves. Morph moves from square to sawtooth to two sawtooths; Sym changes pulse width or the sawtooths’ relative phase; Sub adds a sine-wave sub-oscillator.
Low-pass filter. Saved cutoff: 0.000; resonance: 0.255. Cutoff and resonance are normalized settings, not hertz or instrument display values.
Main envelope: attack 0.000, decay/release 0.185, sustain 0.000. Amp Mod is on, so the main envelope controls loudness.
Cycling Envelope mode: Env. Stored RiseLvl 0.089, FallLvl 0.193, Hold 0.000, Amount 1.000. These are normalized stored fields; rise/fall times in milliseconds remain unverified.
Sine; clock sync off. Stored normalized rate: 0.148; division code: 0. The rate is not a hertz reading, and the musical division has not been converted.
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. The assignment destinations below resolve the saved Assign columns.
Cycling Envelope → Wave / Morph: −1.000. The envelope moves the waveform morph downward.
LFO → Timbre / Sym: +0.729. The sine LFO changes pulse width or sawtooth phasing according to Morph.
ENV → Cutoff: +0.728. The main envelope opens the filter from its zero base setting.
PRESSURE → Assign 1 → Sub: +1.000. Expression adds sub-oscillator level.
PRESSURE → Assign 2 → Decay/Release: +0.683. Expression lengthens decay/release.
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.

The saved main envelope has an immediate attack and no sustained level. Expression changes bass weight and note length. The strong envelope-to-cutoff route opens an otherwise closed filter; Morph and Sym modulation change the oscillator spectrum.

Paraphonic mode is on in the saved export. The PRESSURE matrix row uses pressure or velocity according to the instrument’s global Utility setting; the export does not establish which expression source was used in the session.

Base controls use normalized 0…1 values unless a stored choice code is shown; matrix amounts use −1…+1. These describe saved base settings, before modulation, and are not OLED percentages, hertz or milliseconds.
The saved-parameter inspector preserves the original fields. Oscillator interpretation assumes the documented firmware 5 layout; firmware is not detected from the export.
Matrix columns and assignments follow the Freakout live map and assignment decoder. Mode and waveform labels follow the MicroFreak Reader definitions.
Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations explains matrix sources, destinations and the expression row.

Model: Bass. Microfreak/UG/06 Dig Osc/03 Types/14 BASS
Low-pass filter. Saved cutoff: 0.101; resonance: 0.512. Microfreak/UG/07 Filter/01 Modifying Sound/01 Low Pass Filter
Main envelope: attack 0.669, decay/release 0.579, sustain 0.781. Amp Mod is on, so the main envelope controls loudness. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/03 Envelope Stages
Cycling Envelope mode: Loop. Stored RiseLvl 0.213, RiseSlp 0.500, FallLvl 0.637, FallSlp 0.500, Hold 0.000, Amount 1.000. Microfreak/UG/09 Envelope Gen/06 Cycling Envelope
Sawtooth, clock sync on; stored division code: 8. Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/01 LFO Shape · Microfreak/UG/08 LFO/02 LFO Rate
Amounts use the signed normalized range −1…+1. Microfreak/UG/05 Connections/02 Matrix and Encoder/01 Sources and Destinations
All other saved matrix amounts are zero.

Held notes swell in slowly. The main envelope adds Fold (+0.968) and opens the cutoff (+0.328) as each note opens. Key pressure adds Saturate (+0.170), Fold (+0.486) and cutoff (+0.187) and lowers Noise through Assign 2 (−0.125); the synced sawtooth LFO adds Noise through Assign 1 (+0.203).
The PRESSURE matrix row follows the instrument's global expression setting, which the export does not record.
Turning Shape up raises Noise and makes the pad work as a noisy bass in the low register, as heard from 05:15 in GitP/A/Session/26/11/01-Sun.

In GitP/A/Session/26/11/06-Fri it was the only preset for the whole session: low C and G pedals swelled with key pressure, a high G5, and a C-major third at 22:39. Recorded knob changes covered Fold, Saturate, Noise, cutoff and resonance, filter amount, and the main and cycling envelopes. A read of slot 259 on November 7, 2026 again matched the October 25 export.

In GitP/A/Session/26/11/01-Sun the Launchpad Pro played it from 00:00 to 18:17. Recorded knob changes covered the main and cycling envelopes, filter amount, Spice, LFO rate and the three oscillator controls, with brief cutoff and resonance changes. A read of slot 259 after the session matched the October 25 export, so the slot still holds the factory sound. The session MIDI holds those knob changes as controller messages.

A short lead two octaves up: the main envelope has no attack and no sustain, and it opens the cutoff (+0.444) on each note. Key pressure is the main expressive control, driving Fold at full amount (+1.000) and Saturate (+0.373). The square LFO adds a small pitch modulation (+0.073) whose speed follows the LFO rate.
The PRESSURE matrix row follows the instrument's global expression setting, which the export does not record.

The Assign 3 destination is unresolved. Its saved destination ID is 0x0904, which the Freakout live map lists as an address of the Assign 3 field itself. Assign 3 stores the same ID in 70 of the 384 Factory 6.0 presets. In the session commentary at 21:28, the instrument shows this KEY/ARP → Assign 3 destination as "move".

In GitP/A/Session/26/11/01-Sun it was played from the MicroFreak keys from 18:17 to the end, with almost continuous pressure and pitch bends from 22:46. Recorded knob changes covered attack, decay, sustain, the cycling envelope, filter amount, the free LFO rate, Noise and Fold. At 25:15 pressure was routed through Assign 1 to the main envelope's attack, a matrix edit the capture does not record. A read of slot 260 after the session matched the October 25 export, so the slot still holds the factory sound. The session MIDI holds the knob changes as controller messages.
